title: Garmin Ski Season

panels.description: Days until the season opens, or the day of the season once it has started (counted for 150 days). Set the opening date with the "Season opens" variable (MM-DD).

targets.rawSql: WITH today AS (SELECT ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AS d), opening AS (SELECT d, to_date(extract(year FROM d)::int || '-' || ${SeasonStart:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS this_year FROM today), season AS (SELECT d, CASE WHEN this_year > d THEN this_year ELSE (this_year + interval '1 year')::date END AS next_start FROM opening) SELECT CASE WHEN d - (next_start - interval '1 year')::date < 150 THEN 'Day ' || (d - (next_start - interval '1 year')::date + 1) ELSE (next_start - d) || ' days to go' END AS "Ski season" FROM season

panels.description: Elevation gained on foot and on skins in the last 7 days: ski touring, snowshoeing, hiking, trail and road running, walking, stairs. Cycling and lift-served skiing are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day') SELECT COALESCE(sum(gain) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 7), 0) AS value FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking')

panels.description: Average weekly vertical on foot over the last 4 weeks. Compare it with the "Weekly vertical goal" variable and the goal line below.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day') SELECT COALESCE(sum(gain) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 28), 0) / 4 AS value FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking')

panels.description: Hours of uphill sessions in the last 7 days: ski touring, snowshoeing, hiking, stairs, and any other activity on foot with at least 300 m of climbing.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day') SELECT COALESCE(sum(secs) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 7), 0) / 3600 AS value FROM acts WHERE (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline') OR (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking') AND gain >= 300))

panels.description: Longest uphill session in the last 4 weeks. Build it towards the length of your longest planned tour day.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day') SELECT max(secs) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 28) / 3600 AS value FROM acts WHERE (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline') OR (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking') AND gain >= 300))

panels.description: Strength sessions in the last 14 days. Two a week (green) protects knees and keeps legs strong through the season.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day') SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 14) AS value FROM acts WHERE sport = 'Strength'

panels.description: Activity training load of the last 7 days divided by the weekly average of the last 4 weeks. 0.8-1.3 (green) is a steady build; above 1.5 (red) the load rises faster than your body is used to. Below 0.8 (blue) is a recovery or taper week.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day'), sums AS (SELECT sum(load) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 7) AS acute, sum(load) FILTER (WHERE day > ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 28) / 4 AS chronic FROM acts) SELECT acute / NULLIF(chronic, 0) AS value FROM sums

panels.description: Latest VO2 max estimate: running, or cycling if you have no running estimate in the last year. Garmin updates it only after qualifying outdoor runs, walks or rides, so it can be days or weeks old.

targets.rawSql: WITH daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, avg(health_number(fields, 'VO2_max_value')) AS running, avg(health_number(fields, 'VO2_max_value_cycling')) AS cycling FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'VO2_Max' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND time >= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '366 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1), preference AS (SELECT count(running) > 0 AS has_running FROM daily) SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, CASE WHEN has_running THEN running ELSE cycling END AS "VO2 max" FROM daily CROSS JOIN preference WHERE day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND CASE WHEN has_running THEN running ELSE cycling END IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Uphill engine: vertical, time and aerobic base

panels.description: Elevation gained per week (Monday start) on foot and on skins, by sport. The dashed line is the "Weekly vertical goal" variable; clear it to hide the line.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, sport AS metric, sum(gain) AS value FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT w AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, NULLIF(${VerticalGoal:sqlstring}, '')::numeric AS "Weekly goal" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}), $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, interval '1 week') AS w ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vertical on foot per week

panels.description: Hours per week by discipline. Garmin activity types are grouped: ski touring (backcountry), resort, nordic, hiking & trail, stairs & incline, running, cycling, strength, mobility.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, sport AS metric, sum(secs) / 3600 AS value FROM acts GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Training time per week by discipline

panels.description: Metres climbed per moving hour, one point per uphill session with at least 200 m of gain. Garmin only reports the whole session, so time going down is included: compare similar routes. A rising trend means a stronger engine on the skin track.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time, gain / (COALESCE(NULLIF(moving, 0), secs) / 3600) AS "Vertical per moving hour" FROM acts WHERE (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline') OR (sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing', 'Hiking & trail', 'Stairs & incline', 'Running', 'Walking') AND gain >= 300)) AND gain >= 200 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(moving, 0), secs) > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Climbing rate on uphill sessions

panels.description: Hours per week in each heart-rate zone across all activities. A strong base for long tour days is built mostly in zones 1-2, with a little zone 4-5 work.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, sum(health_number(fields, 'hrTimeInZone_1')) / 3600 AS "Zone 1 (warm up)", sum(health_number(fields, 'hrTimeInZone_2')) / 3600 AS "Zone 2 (easy)", sum(health_number(fields, 'hrTimeInZone_3')) / 3600 AS "Zone 3 (aerobic)", sum(health_number(fields, 'hrTimeInZone_4')) / 3600 AS "Zone 4 (threshold)", sum(health_number(fields, 'hrTimeInZone_5')) / 3600 AS "Zone 5 (maximum)" FROM acts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in heart-rate zones per week

panels.description: Sets per week from Garmin strength workouts, grouped by exercise category. Legs & hips (squats, lunges, deadlifts, step-ups, jumps) carry you through moguls, breakable crust and long descents.

targets.rawSql: WITH sets AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN tags->>'ExerciseCategory' ~ '^(SQUAT|LUNGE|DEADLIFT|CALF_RAISE|LEG_CURL|HIP_RAISE|HIP_STABILITY|HIP_SWING|PLYO|OLYMPIC_LIFT)$' THEN 'Legs & hips' WHEN tags->>'ExerciseCategory' ~ '^(CORE|CRUNCH|PLANK|SIT_UP|LEG_RAISE|CHOP|HYPEREXTENSION)$' THEN 'Core & back' WHEN tags->>'ExerciseCategory' ~ '^(BENCH_PRESS|CURL|FLYE|LATERAL_RAISE|PULL_UP|PUSH_UP|ROW|SHOULDER_PRESS|SHOULDER_STABILITY|SHRUG|TRICEPS_EXTENSION)$' THEN 'Upper body' ELSE 'Other' END AS area FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, area AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM sets GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Strength sets per week by body area

panels.description: Sum of Garmin activity training load per week, with the 4-week average. Raise it gradually; a week well above the average is when overuse injuries start.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '29 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '1 day'), weeks AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) - interval '3 weeks', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, interval '1 week')::date AS week), weekly AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date AS week, sum(load) AS load FROM acts GROUP BY 1), series AS (SELECT week, COALESCE(load, 0) AS load, avg(COALESCE(load, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY week ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average FROM weeks LEFT JOIN weekly USING (week)) SELECT week::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, load AS "Weekly load", average AS "4-week average" FROM series WHERE week >= date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training load per week

panels.description: Higher than your usual is generally better. Dots: daily value. Line: 7-day average (shown once 3 of the 7 days have data). Shaded: your usual range, the mean ± 1 standard deviation of the 28 days before each day (shown once 14 of those days have data). A value outside your own range says more than one compared with population norms.

targets.rawSql: WITH daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, avg(health_number(fields, 'avgOvernightHrv')) AS value FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'SleepSummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '37 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1), days AS (SELECT generate_series(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 35, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day), series AS (SELECT day, value, CASE WHEN count(value) OVER w7 >= 3 THEN avg(value) OVER w7 END AS avg7, avg(value) OVER w28 AS base, greatest(coalesce(stddev_samp(value) OVER w28, 0), 2) AS spread, count(value) OVER w28 AS n FROM days LEFT JOIN daily USING (day) WINDOW w7 AS (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w28 AS (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 28 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, value AS "Overnight HRV", avg7 AS "7-day average", CASE WHEN n >= 14 THEN base + spread END AS "Usual range", CASE WHEN n >= 14 THEN base - spread END AS "Usual low" FROM series WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Overnight HRV

panels.description: Totals per snow sport in the selected time range: days on snow, sessions, hours, vertical and top speed. Fills once you record ski touring, resort, nordic or snowshoe activities; widen the time range to cover the whole season.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT sport AS "Sport", count(DISTINCT day) AS "Days", count(*) AS "Sessions", sum(secs) / 3600 AS "Hours", sum(gain) AS "Vertical up", sum(loss) AS "Vertical down", sum(dist) / 1000 AS "Distance", max(max_speed) * 3.6 AS "Max speed" FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Resort skiing', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Season on snow

panels.description: Every snow session in the selected time range, newest first. Open Garmin Stats for the GPS track and heart rate of a single session.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time AS "Time", fields->>'activityName' AS "Name", sport AS "Sport", fields->>'locationName' AS "Location", secs / 3600 AS "Hours", gain AS "Vertical up", loss AS "Vertical down", dist / 1000 AS "Distance", max_speed * 3.6 AS "Max speed", avg_hr AS "Avg HR", load AS "Training load" FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Resort skiing', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Snow sessions

panels.description: Vertical per week on snow: climbed on skins and snowshoes, descended at the resort and on tours.

targets.rawSql: WITH acts AS (SELECT time, COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, CASE WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'backcountry|ski_?tour|splitboard' THEN 'Ski touring' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cross_country_ski|skate_ski|classic_ski|nordic' THEN 'Nordic skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'ski|snowboard' THEN 'Resort skiing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'snowshoe' THEN 'Snowshoeing' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'hik|mountaineer|trail_run' THEN 'Hiking & trail' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'stair|floor_climb|incline' THEN 'Stairs & incline' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'run' THEN 'Running' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'cycl|bik|ride|spin' THEN 'Cycling' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'walk' THEN 'Walking' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'strength|hiit' THEN 'Strength' WHEN fields->>'activityType' ~* 'yoga|pilates|stretch|mobility|breath' THEN 'Mobility' ELSE 'Other' END AS sport, health_number(fields, 'elevationGain') AS gain, health_number(fields, 'elevationLoss') AS loss, health_number(fields, 'elapsedDuration') AS secs, health_number(fields, 'movingDuration') AS moving, health_number(fields, 'distance') AS dist, health_number(fields, 'maxSpeed') AS max_speed, health_number(fields, 'averageHR') AS avg_hr, health_number(fields, 'activityTrainingLoad') AS load, fields FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'ActivitySummary' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND fields->>'activityName' IS DISTINCT FROM 'END' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, sum(gain) FILTER (WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Snowshoeing', 'Nordic skiing')) AS "Climbed", sum(loss) AS "Descended" FROM acts WHERE sport IN ('Ski touring', 'Resort skiing', 'Nordic skiing', 'Snowshoeing') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vertical on snow per week
Training status and readiness (needs training_status / training_readiness in FETCH_SELECTION)

panels.description: Acute (7-day) against chronic (4-week) training load. Shaded: Garmin's minimum to maximum chronic-load range. Acute load well above chronic load means a fast ramp-up.

targets.rawSql: WITH daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, avg(health_number(fields, 'dailyTrainingLoadAcute')) AS c0, avg(health_number(fields, 'dailyTrainingLoadChronic')) AS c1, avg(health_number(fields, 'maxTrainingLoadChronic')) AS c2, avg(health_number(fields, 'minTrainingLoadChronic')) AS c3 FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'TrainingStatus' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1), days AS (SELECT generate_series(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 0, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, daily.c0 AS "Acute load", daily.c1 AS "Chronic load", daily.c2 AS "Range high", daily.c3 AS "Range low" FROM days LEFT JOIN daily USING (day) WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training load: acute vs chronic

panels.description: Garmin's bands: 95+ prime, 75-94 high, 50-74 moderate, 25-49 low, below 25 poor.

targets.rawSql: WITH daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, (array_agg(health_number(fields, 'score') ORDER BY time) FILTER (WHERE health_number(fields, 'score') IS NOT NULL))[1] AS c0 FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'TrainingReadiness' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1), days AS (SELECT generate_series(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 0, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, daily.c0 AS "Morning readiness" FROM days LEFT JOIN daily USING (day) WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date ORDER BY 1
